title: Stability of the Injectivity Radius and the Cut Locus of Submanifolds under Perturbations
summary: The continuity of the injectivity radius of a compact manifold under $C^2$ perturbation of the Riemannian metric was originally proved by P. Ehrlich (Composito Math., 1974), and later the proof was simplified by T. Sakai (Math. J. Okayama Univ., 1983). Using this continuity, jointly with J. Itoh and S. Prasad (J. Math. Anal. Appl., 2025), we proved the Hausdorff stability of the cut locus of a point, when both the point and the metric are perturbed. In the present article, we extend both these results to submanifolds.
